authContract.tokenPolicy: Use an authenticated admin session or bearer token outside repository artifacts. Do not store cookies, JWTs, refresh tokens, OTPs, payment keys, QR tokens, or PII.

runtimeArtifact.notes: The API image packages only the sanitized Gate Ledger JSON artifact, not the evidence directory or provider payloads.

expectedValues.firstBlockingGate: present while initialized required gates remain BLOCKED or missing evidence

redaction: Gate rows expose evidenceRefs, approval metadata, failure/caveat reason, compensatingMonitoring, and rollbackOrCloseTrigger only.
Response must not include raw filesystem paths, Toss keys, paymentKey values, cookies, JWTs, OTPs, QR tokens, full PII, or raw provider payloads.

missingOrInvalidRuntimeArtifact.operatorMeaning: A missing runtime artifact is a no-go Gate Ledger state, not an API crash and never PASS evidence.

commandShape: Verify firstBlockingGate exists and finalEnableAllowed=false until every required Gate Ledger row is PASS or explicitly approved non-PASS.

cutoverPolicy.bookingEnabledRule: BOOKING_ENABLED=true remains blocked while any required gate is BLOCKED, FAIL, missing evidence, or unapproved non-PASS.
